coverage_rule: Each DMD uses its own fully recorded trials; gaps >3 median frame intervals split acquisition segments. Every statistical window must fit a segment; 90-degree trials also require complete +/-0.75-s display coverage. Trials require finite eligible-source native frames in both channels, including the interpolation bracketing frames; stored NaN warm-up frames are not filled.
november_reference: Unchanged frozen glutamate rows; primary native replay verified.
statistics: Raw p<0.05 and abs(MI)>0.1, either sign; denominator eligible joint-testable.
